stickers.name: Faust Dragon
stickers.description: Powerful and confident, some have nicknamed her “The Femme Fatale of Dragon City” because she can use her shiny blue eyes to drive her opponents so crazy that they attack themselves.

stickers.name: Sentence Dragon
stickers.description: Citizens with clean criminal records don’t know this dragon, but those who have broken the law hide whenever they see him, for he’s the one who carries out all of Deus’ sentences.

stickers.name: Dragotron Dragon
stickers.description: The latest alien experiment: a baby dragon transformed into a space robot — a robot so powerful that, when used for bad, could be destructive. Master him and use his power and technology for good!

stickers.name: Molluck Dragon
stickers.description: The twisted mind of this experimental project. He thinks that the future of all dragons is to become aliens, so he wants to include them in his genetic experiments and turn them into space creatures at any cost.

stickers.name: Sword Wielder Dragon
stickers.description: The Sword Wielder Dragon is one of the most skilled dragons. He runs with his pack of wolves, is a hunter by nature, and a master with the sword. This highly-trained dragon is effective in battle and lets his instincts and his sword be his guide.

stickers.name: Brown Haired Dragon
stickers.description: This brown-haired beauty is respected, feared, and loved. This dragon may be sweet and loved by all but don’t let her fool you. She’s not afraid to defend what’s hers and take what she wants by fire if necessary.

stickers.name: Golden Hand Dragon
stickers.description: The arrogance of the Golden Hand Dragon has led him to many places. This dragon believes he’s royalty and will go out of his way to prove he’s the best expert in battle, even if it means buying himself a golden hand.

stickers.name: Cruel Dragon
stickers.description: In spite of being cowardly and tyrannical, this dragon thinks he’s the greatest king the world has ever seen. He causes lots of problems and has an unstable personality. Will you be able to master him?

stickers.name: Cow Dragon
stickers.description: The farmers always suspected that she wasn’t a real cow: Her milk was spicy, and one fine day she grew wings! It was then that they decided to send her to Dragon City, where she would fit in better.

stickers.name: Pig Dragon
stickers.description: This pig is no Babe. It loves to torment the sheep and the other pigs. Even the farmer has been afraid of it ever since he saw it flying by his window under the light of a full moon.

stickers.name: Sheep Dragon
stickers.description: Earthquakes happen when the Sheep Dragon bleats. Under all that lovely white wool, there’s a cold black heart. This is a very dangerous creature.

stickers.name: White Alien Dragon
stickers.description: Does this dragon look familiar to you? You might spot a similar creature roaming your Islands, but you should know that the White Alien Dragon is, in fact, an imposter. His obsession with a mystic tribe has brought him here...

stickers.name: Impassible Dragon
stickers.description: This dragon is used to being the king wherever he goes. He doesn’t like anyone getting in his way or trying to outdo him. He will stop anyone from catching up to him, by fair means or foul

stickers.name: Voodoo Witcher Dragon
stickers.description: Try not to aggravate a Voodoo Witcher Dragon. All they need to ruin your life is a voodoo doll!

stickers.name: Supernova Dragon
stickers.description: There are entire galaxies mapped out on this dragon's skin. The positions of the little luminous dots move as the universe changes.

stickers.name: Fervor Dragon
stickers.description: He has the temperament of a demon and the greatness of a god. He's one of the leaders of the fire element.

stickers.name: Gravity Dragon
stickers.description: A prodigy of nature. He has a central magic that holds his body in balance. Gravity is his ally, and thanks to that, he’s never lost even one scale.

stickers.name: Sap Dragon
stickers.description: This dragon is made entirely out of sap, so she’s a very good friend of all the Nature Dragons. When their skin feels a bit dry, they just rub themselves against the Sap Dragon and immediately feel better.

stickers.name: Nazca Dragon
stickers.description: She has a sweet look but takes advantage of all the travelers who dare to go through the forest. She doesn't let them continue with their journey unless they pay her.

stickers.name: Imp Dragon
stickers.description: This mischievous dragon is always seeking attention, but his pranks can be a bit upsetting sometimes. In the end, he's just a lonely little creature who gets too bored.

stickers.name: Side-T Dragon
stickers.description: The Side-T Dragon defies science and has the most endurance in Dragon City. This peppy dragon can survive on very little sleep and the word ‘fatigue’ isn’t even in his vocabulary. Any dragon up against him is usually exhausted within minutes.

stickers.name: Gouache Dragon
stickers.description: The Gouache Dragon is a troublemaker, prankster, and the ultimate instigator. This mischievous dragon is constantly causing trouble for her own entertainment and thinks she’s slick, but she always leaves a trail.

stickers.name: Brawl Dragon
stickers.description: The Brawl Dragon loves a good scuffle. He goes around Dragon City looking for trouble and lives for the roar of the crowd. When he’s not scouting enemies to destroy, he’s in the gym working on becoming stronger for the next battle.

stickers.name: Furfur Dragon
stickers.description: The Furfur Dragon is from the thick, tropical rainforest and is at one with nature. This shy, bushy dragon prefers to seek her enemies out behind the comfort of green thickets and robust trees making her the queen of camouflage.

stickers.name: Mad Scientist Dragon
stickers.description: The Mad Scientist Dragon is an unsettling mastermind. He’s constantly scheming and stays up late concocting battle potions to sell on the black market. Beware of his toxic liquids and maniacal laugh.

stickers.name: Zhu Dragon
stickers.description: Normally, the Zhu Dragon is covered in mud and oinking around but since he knew it was Chinese New Year, he decided to spruce up a bit. This friendly creature invites everyone to come and celebrate in his temple.

stickers.name: Cupcake Dragon
stickers.description: Life can be a bit tough for the Cupcake Dragon because every dragon wants to eat her, and they get upset when they can’t. Although she spends most of her time dodging sharp dragon teeth, she’s usually a good sport.

stickers.name: Admirer Dragon
stickers.description: The Admirer Dragon is the king of discreet and wants every dragon to feel special. Any dragon with a crush relies on this jolly creature to deliver gifts, candy, and letters to their special crush without disclosing their identity.

stickers.name: Mischievous Dragon
stickers.description: The Mischievous Dragon is known for his bright colors, love of the sea, and trickster ways, but this fancy dragon has a bad reputation of showing off. However, what comes across as pride, is a powerful defense mechanism used to deter attackers.

stickers.name: Precious Dragon
stickers.description: The Precious Dragon is one tough cookie, but when battles get too intense, she likes to go to her happy places. If you’re looking for her, she’s sure to be found in any small space that's filled with shiny objects.

stickers.name: Book Dragon
stickers.description: The Book Dragon never loses a battle, what’s his secret? Unlimited knowledge. This brainy dragon knows all the secrets and best techniques. He’s dedicated his life to learning all there is to know about being the best and most powerful dragon.

stickers.name: Impure Dragon
stickers.description: The Impure Dragon has an agenda to undo all the good deeds of the Pure Dragon. This fierce creature likes to bring the doom and gloom and hates seeing peaceful and happy dragons. Any good deed he’s ever done has always been by accident.

stickers.name: Multidimensional Dragon
stickers.description: The Multidimensional Dragon is connected to all the realms within the Dragonverse. He can locate any dragon on command. If dragons are looking for a nice vacation, they better inform this dragon first, or else there will be a search out for them.

stickers.name: Lil Cricket Dragon
stickers.description: The Lil Cricket Dragon is very special. This extraordinary dragon is known for her generosity to all Dragon Masters. The rose on her tail is a symbol of who she is on the inside and out: kind-hearted and filled with light.

stickers.name: Platform Dragon
stickers.description: The Platform Dragon always wanted to be a tall, adult dragon so she could prance around in platform heels. But, when she grew up, she remained small. To make up for lost time, she lives in a giant heel and makes the battlefield her ultimate runway.

stickers.name: Darksteel Dragon
stickers.description: The Darksteel Dragon is highly unpredictable, you never know when he’s going to strike, but when he does it’s pure destruction. Using his sword, he can unleash over 200 million volts of legendary energy leaving his enemies fried.

stickers.name: Castle Dragon
stickers.description: Who doesn’t love a beautiful castle? That’s exactly what the Castle Dragon wants his enemies to think. This sneaky dragon is the master of disguise and doesn’t have to do much to lead his enemies into his trap! Once they’re inside, there’s virtually no escaping.

stickers.name: Baker Dragon
stickers.description: The Baker Dragon runs a bakery right by the farms on the floating islands. He's famous for the enormous cake he bakes every year around Dragon City's Anniversary. It's big enough for every dragon in the city to grab a slice!

stickers.name: Tentacle Dragon
stickers.description: The Tentacle Dragon is a dangerous one. This fatal dragon is protected at all times. Sometimes she accidentally stuns other dragons just because they’ve gotten too close. She usually keeps to herself and can be seen floating in water habitats.

stickers.name: Arctic Dragon
stickers.description: The Arctic Dragon is a huntress from the northern mountains. Her ice wings help her zip through the air and her double coated fur provides built-in insulation. Her enemies rarely escape as she has acute skills and can survive for hours without sleep.

stickers.name: Broken Halo
stickers.description: A halo that used to belong to a fallen forest angel. Found in the Tower, Maze & Runner Islands, Quests, Dragon TV, and in Warrior's Chests inside the Arenas.

stickers.name: Duo-Delight Dragon
stickers.description: Dynamic Duos unite! Master of the Happy element, Duo-Delight Dragons appear along the forest floor during fall. They happily snuffle for autumnal treats under the golden leaves, oblivious of the forest politics happening above – bliss!

stickers.description: If you want to find this dragon, you don’t need to look for him, you just need to follow the sand trail he leaves behind. He is a bit clumsy, but everybody loves him.

stickers.name: Demigod Dragon
stickers.description: Entire cities have fallen at his feet. In the Middle Ages, this dragon was feared but also worshipped because whoever he favored in a war would win. Add him to your team and he will make you king.

stickers.name: Voltage Dragon
stickers.description: This dragon's habitat is a high-risk area, mainly on stormy days. He's dangerous to have around even for Deus — he makes his hair stand up. High voltage!

stickers.name: Wispy Dragon
stickers.description: This beautiful dragon arrives quietly, but when he leaves, you know he’s been around because of the trail of refreshing mist left in his wake.

stickers.name: Doctor Dragon
stickers.description: Before you even ask, the answer is yes: Dragon doctors’ handwriting is just as bad as human doctors’; but apart from that, they're really helpful after Quests and League battles.

stickers.name: Solstice Dragon
stickers.description: This dragon can only be found on the longest night of the year, when the winter solstice takes place. So if you find one, persuade him to come with you! You’ll only get one opportunity per year!

stickers.name: The Kind Dragon
stickers.description: The Kind Dragon can change the world with his goodwill. If you need a helping hand, the Kind Dragon is there for you. If you need to win a battle, the Kind Dragon will win it for you.

stickers.name: Thorny Rose
stickers.description: Thorny Roses are found in the Thorny Road Pass and Event Islands

Just make sure to keep your own dessert out of reach, or it might vanish in the blink of an eye!

stickers.description: The Wailing Dragon is the son of a banshee sent out into the world to herald the ill fate of those who stray from a noble path. stickers.description: The Lancelot Dragon is the rock star of dragons, and his noble feats, some of which are the stuff of legend, have earned him a devoted fan base. His reputation extends far and wide, but when challenged, the clear streams of the Sea Arena aren’t enough to cool off his rage.

stickers.name: Mirror Mage Dragon
stickers.description: A master of deceit, the Mirror Mage Dragon tricks valiant dragons into seeing their own malevolent reflections. As each dragon looks into his mirror, a terrifying alternate version of themselves is created.

stickers.name: Arcana Fool Dragon
stickers.description: Age of Arcana: They drain the life from all foes at once. Number 0, better known as the Arcana Fool Dragon, lost his Chaos status for being too foolish. But befriending this eccentric fellow will actually bring about new beginnings for your Dragonverse adventure!

stickers.name: Hearts Queen Dragon
stickers.description: It is far better to be feared than loved. That's what the Hearts Queen Dragon says. She may not be the best for breeding, but you should try her in battle! Sentence first, verdict later! Off with their heads!

stickers.name: Kringle Kingdom Dragon
stickers.description: Forgotten to decorate your Islands in time for Mr. Kringle's arrival? Don't stress, the Kringle Kingdom Dragon is here to lend a hand. She'll go door-to-door, mobilizing the community to make it the most joyful holiday yet!

stickers.description: The Orca Dragon is a highly social creature, yet this species is often captured by Corrupted dragons and made to perform for their own entertainment... You can give them a safe home in Dragon City Sea Habitats, which contain infinite amounts of water!

stickers.name: Piranha Dragon
stickers.description: Rejected by its freshwater school, the Piranha Dragon now enjoys traveling solo and exploring the deep sea. Its submarine, however, often breaks down at the worst possible moment, leaving this unlucky fellow stranded in the middle of the abyss!

stickers.name: High Siren Dragon
stickers.description: Her melodies may be beautiful, but her motives are far more sinister... Beware, the High Siren Dragon will use her angelic voice to lure naive dragons to their doom. For the Mermaid Dragon, she's just the embarrassing aunt!

stickers.name: Porpoise Dragon
stickers.description: One of the last remaining Porpoise Dragons due to overfishing, this magical beast has managed to survive the greedy clutches of the High Marauder Dragon! Its valuable pearls are usually sold on the black market of the Seven Seas.

stickers.name: Whail Dragon
stickers.description: When this dragon wails, the ocean sky becomes filled with hail. For this beast is no whale, it can shatter glaciers simply with its tail. Take in a deep breath and make sure to exhale, as this dragon's story is like no other tale.

stickers.name: Infested Waters Dragon
stickers.description: If you see a purple fin sticking out of the water, you better hope you're on dry land! The Infested Waters Dragon can smell a tasty Dragon Master from miles away and if it's hungry...well, let's just say it doesn't care who or what it eats!

stickers.name: Sea Titan Dragon
stickers.description: The marine member of the titan deities that once protected Dragon City. The Sea Titan Dragon brought torrential rain to the lands, creating large bodies of water for all aquatic life to come.

stickers.name: Spiked Claws Dragon
stickers.description: The Spikes: Their Impaling Shelter both protects and damages. The Spiked Claws Dragon is one creature you should definitely watch out for at the beach... Buried in the sand with its protruding spikes, one misplaced footstep could be your painful ending.

stickers.name: Mosasire Dragon
stickers.description: The Mosasire Dragon managed to survive the meteor's impact by swimming as fast as he could, but the deadly aftershocks were inescapable... They rattled his skeleton and sent him into a tailspin – now he's a sire of the seas, a ruler of bones!

stickers.name: Koraken Dragon
stickers.description: The sea's most ornate creature, the Koraken Dragon loves to display its coral limbs to Dragon Masters! This species is, however, threatened by the Fuel Dragon and Crude Oil Dragon... It's time to release the Koraken and give them their comeuppance!

stickers.name: Palm Tree Dragon
stickers.description: Found on deserted islands, where shipwrecked dragons often end up, the Palm Tree Dragon survives in harsh conditions, waiting to meet the castaways... If they're nice, it will offer them water, if they pose a threat, it will defend its home with its razor-sharp leaves.

stickers.name: Husk Dragon
stickers.description: An expert on all things Paradise Island, you might think the Husk Dragon is the perfect source of information for the Inspector Dragon – he’s a native after all! Too bad his years of isolation have turned him mad… Now he only speaks in jumbled riddles.

stickers.name: Cavemodo Dragon
stickers.description: Pulled through a wormhole into present-day Dragon City, the Cavemodo Dragon has had to get used to our modern ways, but that doesn't mean he's any less of a fighter. His tracking, hunting, and foraging skills are better than most!

stickers.name: Pettalion Dragon
stickers.description: A battalion of lush, scarlet petals may look beautiful from afar, but Pettalion Dragons are a lot more ferocious when up close. They hunt in packs and will do anything to defend the Red Rose and their leader, the Warose Dragon.

stickers.name: Truthbender Dragon
stickers.description: Sure, the Truthbender Dragon's wooden nose grows longer every time he lies, but what you don't know is that he'll have you believing the lie too! He'll persuade you onto his team without you even realizing.

stickers.name: Red Crested Dragon
stickers.description: The Red Crested Dragon may look like easy prey as she wanders through the woods with food for her grandma, however, this young dragon is actually feared by many... Her secrets lie within her basket. Dare to take a look?

stickers.name: Forest Demon Dragon
stickers.description: Watching over from above, the Forest God Dragon protected the Forest Kingdom, but once the funghi took over, the Forest Demon Dragon was born. Now this demonic God looks up from below, wallowing in the dark, peaty earth.

stickers.name: Wind Dragon
stickers.description: He may look bulky but this breezy dragon can be seen zooming around the stratosphere! The Wind Dragon can control all the air currents and clouds in the sky.  He uses his attacks from a distance, preferring to blow the enemy away, as opposed to close contact.

stickers.name: HotCold Dragon
stickers.description: It was a rare occurrence when a dragon egg came into contact with molten lava and freezing water at the exact same time... The egg didn't freeze nor melt, rather the HotCold Dragon was born! This elemental beast is a master of temperatures.

stickers.name: Arctic Wind Dragon
stickers.description: Wherever the Arctic Wind Dragon flies the temperature drops, covering the land with a frosty glaze. She can hurl powerful ice tornadoes at her foes and even blast ice from her mouth just by freezing the water vapor in the air.

stickers.name: South Wind Dragon
stickers.description: The South Wind Dragon provides essential warm climates for all fauna and flora, as well as for growing produce. However, don't get on the wrong side of this dragon, warm winds can easily stir up a thunderstorm...

stickers.name: East Wind Dragon
stickers.description: When the sun rises each day, the East Wind Dragon is waking up, gracing the lands with the first rays of morning light. This dragon loves to make the summer days longer, but will seldom be seen in winter.

stickers.name: West Wind Dragon
stickers.description: Bringing in the occasional light shower, the West Wind Dragon causes early summer breezes that grace the lands after a harsh winter. This dragon has severe conflicts with the High Zephyr Dragon...

stickers.name: North Wind Dragon
stickers.description: Locations that are subject to the harsh weather of the North Wind Dragon are uninhabitable. This dragon brings in a sweeping cold, forcing other dragons to pack up and leave their home as quickly as possible.

stickers.name: Hurricane Dragon
stickers.description: Unlike other Wind dragons, the Hurricane Dragon has not warmed to the newly formed Wind community. It considers itself an outsider and will form hurricanes just to watch young Wind dragons get blown away and lost forever...

stickers.name: High Typhoon Dragon
stickers.description: Leader of the Dragon Force: After been exposed to a supernatural Meteorite, the High Typhoon Dragon decided to form the ultimate superhero team and use their newfound powers for good! Her specialty? Manipulation of wind and ice.

stickers.name: Wind Lord Dragon
stickers.description: The Wind Lord Dragon is a manipulator of air currents. He uses his abilities to soar through the sky at tremendous speeds with no mercy for anything that gets caught up in the aftermath of tornadoes. You never know where he is, only where he's been.

stickers.name: Pestilence Dragon
stickers.description: The first Rider of the apocalypse is here... The Pestilence Dragon brings sickness, pain, and chaos to those who chose to remain. What better way to pave the way for the incoming Riders of destruction than to weaken the life around.

stickers.name: Famine Dragon
stickers.description: In the wake of plague and the scars of battle, hunger takes hold. The Famine Dragon circles above, watching your resources wither and your strength fade, waiting for the exact moment to strike the final balance.

stickers.name: False Prophet Dragon
stickers.description: A master of misplaced faith, the False Prophet Dragon hides its true, serpentine form behind a cold, rigid mask. Bearing the ancient Mark of the Beast, it weaves through the battlefield offering 'sacred' miracles that mimic the light only to lead the unwary into the heart of the Apocalypse.

stickers.description: Everyone worries about the future, even Deus, especially as the New Year comes around. The Dreadnought Dragon is a physical manifestation of these doubts, but with enough positivity, you can send this beast back to his dark abyss!

stickers.name: Jörmungandr Dragon
stickers.description: Meaning 'huge monster', the Jörmungandr Dragon is a giant serpent-like dragon that is long enough to wrap itself around all of the Islands in Dragon City. When it releases its grasp, the Ragnarök battle will begin.

stickers.name: Spiky Ghoul Dragon
stickers.description: Usually hiding in the undergrowth, the Spiky Ghoul Dragon's hypnotic candles lure trespassing grave-robbers into her deadly spikes...meaning more harvested souls for the crypts.

stickers.name: Illumidepth Dragon
stickers.description: You may think this dragon uses its bioluminescence to attract and eat small prey, when in fact, it will actually use this light to lure much larger prey into a cave full of ravenous Illumidepth Dragons...

stickers.name: Apex Dragon
stickers.description: What do you get when you combine the genetic traits of the Spinokrok Dragon and the Predator X Dragon? The ultimate dino-dragon hybrid! The Apex Dragon shouldn't exist, but it does.

stickers.name: Crude Oil Dragon
stickers.description: Once paid to power Dragon City, the Crude Oil Dragon soon became arrogant and obsessed with wealth. Dragons soon realized he was harming their beautiful environment. We must fight against his black tides of poison.

stickers.name: Lady Luna Dragon
stickers.description: A motherly figure for many, the Lady Luna Dragon is a strong and protective character and is highly respected. She can turn the tides of the oceans and wash away any enemies that try to hurt younger dragons.

stickers.name: Merchant Dragon
stickers.description: The Merchant Dragon is known for the amazing goods he sells to dragons for battles. But if there’s one thing he doesn’t like, it’s getting ripped off. So if you’re going to haggle with him, haggle well…or else he’ll seek revenge.

stickers.name: Wicked Silencer Dragon
stickers.description: Her maniacal cackle alone is enough to silence young dragons camping in the forest... The Wicked Silencer Dragon hides between the trees, casting her silence spells and revealing the wicked smile beneath her mask to those who get too close.

stickers.name: DragiFruit Dragon
stickers.description: The DragiFruit Dragon's tribe is secretive, preferring to isolate themselves while hiding from the Gardener Dragon... They're famous for being beautiful, although other dragons find them a bit bland. But fighting skills matter more than conversation, anyways!

stickers.name: High Nacrea Dragon
stickers.description: The High Arcane Dragon may no longer be around, but as his whispers echo through the halls of the Magi Guild, his powerful, pearly replacement has arrived to take on a whole bunch of spooky threats. Rearrange 'A-R-C-A-N-E' and what do you get? The High Nacrea Dragon!

stickers.name: Illusion Dragon
stickers.description:
This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World!
It's hard to distinguish between real life and illusion when this dragon is around. As a good-natured experiment, he likes to fabricate visions inside the minds of others.

stickers.name: Doom Stitcher Dragon
stickers.description: The Doom Stitcher Dragon weaves your fate with voodoo and dread. Her needles pierce dolls in your likeness, binding you to eternal ruin. As she sews, your doom is secured. Don't let her get hold of your thread.

stickers.name: Mean Spirited Dragon
stickers.description: The Mean Spirited Dragon experiences joy over the misfortune of others... Its crooked smile never fades when it sees someone having a bad day. It even spies on unevenly matched battles just to see lower-level dragons getting defeated!

stickers.name: Ancient Magic Dragon
stickers.description: The truth is, the Ancient Magic Dragon doesn’t really want to be bothered, but dragons across Dragon City seek him out and beg him to be their guru. He’s too nice to say no and would rather help than see younger dragons end up in the wrong hands.

stickers.name: High Flight Armored Dragon
stickers.description: A sky-high defense means taking control from above! The High Flight Armored Dragon uses his colossal wings to soar above the ongoing wars below and relay back any key strategic information. His gusts hold back the enemy line.

stickers.name: Cryo Armored Dragon
stickers.description: An icy defense means freezing your enemies in place! The Cryo Armored Dragon uses her glacial powers to slow down the battlefield with snow while building up mountains of ice. Making contact with her will often freeze the foe before real damage can be taken.

stickers.name: Shimmer Armored Dragon
stickers.description: A shining defense means blinding your enemies! The Shimmer Armored Dragon uses his angelic powers to remain distant from the foe, letting them tire themselves out before delivering a heavenly blow.

stickers.name: Scaly Armored Dragon
stickers.description: A scaly defense means shedding yourself of your enemies! The Scaly Armored Dragon uses her serpentine powers to scale up her armor and take hits easily... Her irridescent body can shed on command.

stickers.name: High Civil Armored Dragon
stickers.description: A strategic defense is the most powerful offense! The High Civil Armored Dragon is an expert in defensive war strategies. He can take crushing blows without waking up from his nap, but when there's civil unrest, he unites the Armored Alliance to restore the peace.

stickers.name: Tidal Armored Dragon
stickers.description: A liquid defense means drowning your enemies! The Tidal Armored Dragon uses the power of the sea to keep his stance strong and armor fluid... Damaging water isn't as easy as you think!

stickers.name: High Blackfall Dragon
stickers.description: The forgotten piece of the Blackvoid-Cybervolt saga, the High Blackfall Dragon only chooses to reappear in autumn time. Although its presence can turn vegetation black, its mecha powers are necessary when facing the Black Friday beasts.

stickers.name: Bandaged Dragon
stickers.description: Mummified against his will years ago in the Ancient World of Dragon City, the Bandaged Dragon has risen from his sarcophagus stronger than ever... His army of mummified eggs will soon hatch to release chaos into the world.

stickers.name: Overgrowth Dragon
stickers.description: For centuries the Overgrowth Dragon laid dormant, waiting to be discovered while nature took its course. Its unmeltable metal might be the only thing capable of defeating the High Ashwing Dragon.

stickers.name: Dauntless Dragon
stickers.description: A present-day supporter of the long-lost Hanshock Dragon, the Dauntless Dragon has studied the ancient story told through generations, and it's clear that his community was wronged... It's time for some sweet revenge!

stickers.name: Damona Dragon
stickers.description: Dragon City’s 10th Birthday collectible: The Damona Dragon is a Tower Guardian whose expert coaching means breeding tasks are sped up! Call her hotline now for the best advice in dragon relationships!

stickers.name: Superseder Dragon
stickers.description: Brother to the Successor Dragon, the Superseder Dragon has come too far to let his sibling get the High Reign Dragon's coveted apprentice spot. It's time to play dirty...

stickers.name: Successor Dragon
stickers.description: Sister to the Superseder Dragon, the Successor Dragon has a few tricks up her sleeve when it comes to outshining her sibling. She's ready to prove herself to the High Reign Dragon and become her successor!

stickers.name: Luscious Locks Dragon
stickers.description: The Luscious Locks Dragon is not your typical damsel in distress, oh no, you can guarantee that wigs will be snatched during battle... Naive Princes will even use her hair to climb up her tower only to find themselves entangled for eternity.

stickers.name: Geckobolt Dragon
stickers.description: With only a handful of confirmed sightings deep in the jungle, the Geckbolt Dragon is an island myth whose existence is both supported and denied by many. Is it real and if so, what does it want?

stickers.name: Secret Plasma Dragon
stickers.description: Warning: Plasma Colony outbreak! Oozing sacs of deadly blood plasma show to any life-stealing predators that the Secret Plasma Dragon is certainly off the menu...if his rotten smell doesn't put them off first!

stickers.name: Bugblaze Dragon
stickers.description: The light of a single Bugblaze Dragon beautifully twinkles in the night sky, the light of a hundred Bugblaze Dragons can destroy the shadows of the High Occult Titan Dragon himself. Is it time to build an army?

stickers.name: Ascended Oracle Dragon
stickers.description: Through long and arduous voyages, the Ascended Oracle Dragon has learned about everything that has ever happened and everything that is yet to happen... What will the Oracle reveal about your future?

stickers.name: Elven Spirit Dragon
stickers.description: Ever got lost in the Draconian forests? Follow the joyful whistles of the Elven Spirit Dragon and it'll lead you to safety. However, beware of the dangerous Rune Wyvern Dragon's imitation whistles...

stickers.name: Super Fresh Dragon
stickers.description: Make room for the Super Fresh Dragon! He's back and fresher than ever... Catch him if you can because it's time to add some style to your team!

stickers.name: Globalio Dragon
stickers.description: Globalia's feisty brother, the Globalio Dragon, has joined the mission to save his previous snowglobe town. The 'friendly' Impostor Dragon is here to lend a hand, but something tells Globalio his new friend might not be as honest as he seems...

stickers.name: Turtorrior Dragon
stickers.description: Warrior, defender, protector; the Turtorrior Dragon is Tiki Bay's first line of defense when it comes to unwanted outsiders. He doesn't take kindly to those who harm his environment so you better be on your best behavior!

stickers.name: Reflected Revenge Dragon
stickers.description: The Triumphant Dragon was simply passing by when the Mirror Mage forced his reflection upon him. Thus, the Reflected Revenge Dragon was born. For he is here not for triumph, but for revenge...

stickers.name: Jarl´s Hammer
stickers.description: Get the Jarl's Hammer in Tower, Maze, Fog & Arena Pass!

stickers.name: Dracarctic Predator Dragon
stickers.description: An ancient species of dragon that has withstood the test of time and survived the apocalypse to live another day. The Dracarctic Predator Dragon now scours the frozen wasteland for food... Don't look back, just run!

stickers.name: Maidens Shield
stickers.description: Found in Maze Islands. Required to complete the Shield Maidens Collection.

stickers.name: High Jotunn Dragon
stickers.description: Wielding a hammer stolen from the Æsir dragons themselves, the High Jotunn Dragon is an ancient creature that unleashes frost and destruction wherever it goes. Nevertheless, it carries great wisdom, being as old as the dragon world itself.

stickers.name: Rune Axe
stickers.description: Get the Rune Axe in Tower, Maze, Fog & Arena Pass!

stickers.name: Globalia Dragon
stickers.description: Growing up in Snowglobia is like living a perfect Christmas movie – hot chocolate, candy canes, gifts, and snow are all year round! But the festive spirit is fading, and the Globalia Dragon must now fight to save her winter community.

stickers.name: Polarized Dragon
stickers.description: Constantly torn between his primal instincts and his moral compass, the Polarized Dragon is a controversial beast among the ice caps. When he tries to do good, electric currents will often travel under the ice, shocking surrounding prey.

stickers.name: Haunted Professor Dragon
stickers.description: While exploring a haunted school, Sam & Colby had a rather terrifying encounter with the Haunted Professor Dragon! He roams the classrooms, looking for Dragon Masters to send to his fiery pits of detention.

stickers.name: Professor Dragon
stickers.description: A highly respected dragon who is certainly capable of creating poisons and toxins, the Professor Dragon is far from a teacher's pet. Some say he has lost his mind, others believe he has a nefarious plan. His alibi? A meeting with the High Diabolical Dragon!

stickers.name: Teacher Dragon
stickers.description: This dragon is respected and loved by the inhabitants of Dragon City. He taught math, geography, and poetry to all of them. He is also very strict: No mischief in his presence!

stickers.name: Note Book
stickers.description: Found in Event Island, Arena Passes, Quests and Dragon TV and try to complete the Bell's Ringing collection!

stickers.name: Grand Intel Dragon
stickers.description: A master of whispers, the Grand Intel Dragon is the Shadow Council's best informant. Keeping secrets is no longer allowed, no matter how small... Inform him of any wrongdoing and be rewarded, otherwise you'll be implicit in the crime!

stickers.name: Timetwister Dragon
stickers.description: A contortionist of timelines, the Timetwister Dragon will sacrifice everything to jump forward to 3025 once the New Year arrives. He says that he sees a utopian future but others have claimed his intentions are much more nefarious.

stickers.name: High Telekinetic Dragon
stickers.description: While keeping the Reanimation & Razor Claws dragons in line, the High Telekinetic Dragon ensures civilian dragons are protected from falling debris and collapsing buildings. The full extext of her powers are yet to be seen... Some say she can move entire Islands with her mind.

stickers.name: Pen and ink
stickers.description: Found in Event Island, Arena Passes, Quests and Dragon TV and try to complete the Bell's Ringing collection!

stickers.name: Storyteller Dragon
stickers.description: Hidden deep in the woods, the Storyteller Dragon recounts a twisted tale of romance, betrayal, and jealousy... Those who gather around will be cursed for eternity by his words, which can only be broken by an act of true love.

stickers.name: Alakazam Dragon
stickers.description: The Alakazam Dragon is no stranger to the annual search of magic scales; a few of his wishes have already been granted! However, his pesky ex-assistant, the Abracadabra Dragon, has double-crossed him and left him behind!

stickers.name: Mercury the Strategist Dragon
stickers.description: The Strategists: Their critical strategies pinpoint your weaknesses. A Strategist named Mercury, are you ready to feel her fury? Once the liquid metal enters your Soul, you begin to lose all control. Accept your fate, it's your duty, time to say goodbye to your Beauty.

stickers.name: Spiked Quills Dragon
stickers.description: The Spikes: Their Impaling Shelter both protects and damages. The Spiked Quills Dragon might look cute at first, but she's the spikiest and most dangerous of all her Spiked family. If you manage to dodge her trail of quills, you'll find a spiky bundle of pain racing towards you.

stickers.name: Renaissance Dragon
stickers.description: Unlike those unfortunate enough for their multiverse counterpart to be formed from pure evil, the Renaissance Dragon is actually a much-needed ray of hope for the Ragnarok Dragon. This paladin of light represents rebirth out of the darkness!

stickers.description: A beautiful dragon that lights up the gloomy forests of Dragon City, usually to help those who have wandered too far. The petals of a Fireflower Dragon's tail are said to have magical properties!

stickers.description: You may not like her humanoid form, but don't be fooled, looks can be deceiving... Her innocent glances hide her expertise in martial arts, meaning she is clearly capable of committing the perfect crime. Her alibi? Kicking butt in the dojo!

stickers.name: Flower Float Dragon
stickers.description: The Flower Float Dragon is a living parade in full bloom, draped in garlands that never wilt and carrying the joy of celebration wherever she roams. But beneath those vibrant petals and that festive spirit lies a dragon of deep roots and ancient power. She brings color to the greyest of days, yet those who trample her garden learn quickly that the most beautiful things in nature also know how to protect themselves.

stickers.name: Beautiful Dragon
stickers.description: The obvious favorite to be crowned this year's Summer Queen, the Beautiful Dragon has come too far for someone else to snatch her well-deserved flower crown! Being a creature of pure Beauty is hard work, but it won't stop her attempts to impress the Midsummer Dragon.

stickers.name: Twinkle Dragon
stickers.description: The bright twinkles in the distance aren't a TV tower or radio mast... It's actually the Twinkle Dragon! Nesting in a secret chamber atop Star Mountain, this friendly fellow protects the final pieces of the Star and can make all your wishes come true!

stickers.name: Aello Dragon
stickers.description: Belonging to a gusty tale set among mountainous peaks and treacherous heights, the Aello Dragon's story isn't for the faint-hearted. Usually hunting in packs, it swoops down to catch its prey and then drops the food into the ravenous nest below.

stickers.name: Serpent Extractor Dragon
stickers.description: The Extractors: They feed off the souls of their enemies. The Serpent Extractor Dragon used to only have one head, but after consuming too many enemy souls and filling up on noodles, two extra heads popped out! Now it has thrice the chance to strike its foe and sink its teeth in.

stickers.name: Void Custodian Dragon
stickers.description: A sentinel of the silent depths, this warden ensures that what enters the darkness never returns. It patrols the boundaries of reality, using its spectral reach to drag trespassers back into the lightless deep.

stickers.name: Antarcticlaw Dragon
stickers.description: A bizarre creature locked in the ice for millennia, the Antarcticlaw has finally made its gruesome reappearance into the world. Its claws can cut through ice, flesh, and bone, making it the perfect weapon for the High Zero Dragon.

stickers.name: Drag-On Dragon
stickers.description: Pronouns: they/them. It's time to get your drag on with the beloved Drag-On Dragon! They ensure your Islands are a safe space by promoting diversity, equality, and artistic expression for dragons and Dragon Masters of all ages.

stickers.name: Snowscape Dragon
stickers.description: An inhabitant of the mysterious snowy mountains, the Snowscape Dragon's existence used to be a myth until one naive Dragon Master wandered into his lair... He's a friendly ally now – but the disappearance of skiers is still an open case...

stickers.name: High Risen Ice Dragon
stickers.description: Once bound by the limits of Common powers, the Ice Dragon has risen from the snow and become a beast of Heroic majesty and might! This frosty friend intends to help other Common hatchlings tap into their risen potential!

stickers.name: High Zero Dragon
stickers.description: It all started with Zero, and one by one, the Ten was formed. It's been decades since they fought together, but the High Zero Dragon has reached out to Five and Seven in hope of a new uprising. Meanwhile, as his frozen monsters begin to thaw out, his glacial army grows.

stickers.name: Hailing Evader Dragon
stickers.description: The Evaders: They hit hard while dodging attacks. When the hail starts to feel like tiny shards of glass puncturing your skin, you can bet the Hailing Evader Dragon is close by. It will follow you, unseen in the shadows, waiting for the pain to get the best of you.

stickers.name: High Stained Sharpfang
stickers.description: Beneath its coiled horns and venom-tipped tongue lies a strike that never hesitates. The High Stained Sharpfang doesn't stalk its prey, it ambushes it, turning a single bite into a wound that lingers long after the fangs pull away.

stickers.name: Stained DreadSting
stickers.description: Armored in molten plates and crowned with curling horns, the Stained Dreadsting doesn't chase its enemies, it corners them. One strike from its barbed tail is a promise: the fight is already decided, the venom just hasn't caught up yet.

stickers.name: Stained Belladone
stickers.description: Wrapped in petals that bloom only to poison, the Stained Belladone offers a single touch and asks nothing in return, except everything. Its drifting berries hum with toxin, and by the time the fragrance fades, the enemy has already breathed in more than they can survive.
